newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Cafe de Coral sells HK$57.5 mln property.
newsitem.headline: Cafe de Coral sells HK$57.5 mln property.

text.p: Fast food restaurant operator Cafe de Coral Holdings Ltd has agreed to sell a Hong Kong property to an independent third party for HK$57.52 million, it said in a announcement on Friday.

The company said it anticipated the sale of the property on Nathan Road in Hong Kong's Mongkok district to give rise to net profits of about HK$52 million and the proceeds were intended to be used as general working capital.
It also said it decided to sell the property as it was not appropriate for restaurant use. Completion of the deal was expected on November 30, it added.
